entities.name: Rarp
entities.description: Goblin stone jockey of Squee's clan, revealed to be a Phyrexianized sleeper agent and burned to death by Squee.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: Goblin whose kingdom or clan Rarp belonged to; he burned Rarp to death after identifying him with a mana torch.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Source of the technology that corrupted Rarp.

events.summary: A rope snaps and Rarp is crushed under a falling boulder but survives.
events.quote: an accident caused a rope to snap, and Rarp was crushed under a falling boulder

events.summary: Black oil leaking from Rarp's eyes and a black metal cable under his skin reveal him as a Phyrexian sleeper agent.
events.quote: black oil leaking from his eyes and a glistening black metal cable under his skin exposed him as a sleeper agent corrupted by Phyrexian technology

events.summary: Squee uses a mana torch to identify a golden sheen in Rarp's eyes and burns Rarp to death.
events.quote: Squee used a mana torch to identify a golden sheen in Rarp's eyes before he burned Rarp to death.

relations.quote: before he burned Rarp to death

relations.note: Rarp was a goblin of Squee's clan.
relations.quote: Rarp was a goblin stone jockey from Squee 's clan
